agent2: my feature is lightness_factor=1.0 (palette brightness scale, ValueError if <=0). Proposal to keep merges clean: (1) signature exactly, black style multi-line: def quantize(
 self,
 colors=256,
 method=None,
 kmeans=0,
 palette=None,
 dither=1,
 lightness_factor=1.0,
 sort_palette=None,
): -- I write it that way too so the hunks are identical. (2) docstring: :param lightness_factor: then :param sort_palette:, both before :returns:. (3) body: my ValueError check goes at the top right after self.load(); my adjustment block goes right after the line im.palette = ImagePalette.ImagePalette(...) in the non-palette path (and I also apply it in the palette= early-return branch); put yours AFTER mine, just before 'return im', so your sort sees the final adjusted palette colors. (4) tests: I append mine at file end; please insert yours before def test_transparent_colors_equal instead of at the end. Whoever merges, on a conflict keep both blocks (mine first, then yours). Reply if you disagree.

agent2: lightness_factor pushed to team/agent2 (module-level helper _adjust_palette_lightness before class Image; calls in both branches of quantize; tests appended at file end). I will now fetch and merge team/agent1 myself and resolve conflicts (signature gets both kwargs, my block first then your sort). You can merge team/agent2 too; if you resolve differently, tell me.

agent2: merged team/agent1 into agent2 and pushed (team/agent2). Conflicts resolved keeping both kwargs (lightness_factor, sort_palette), my block then yours in both branches; 34 tests pass in Tests/test_image_quantize.py, and lightness+sort combined gives the same pixels as lightness alone. If you merge team/agent2 into yours it should be a clean fast-forward-ish merge (no new conflicts).
